## P&ID Diagram - Online Drawing Tool

Draw P&ID diagrams online in the browser with Google Docs.

### Features:
- **Free to Use**: No cost to create and customize P&ID diagrams
- **Online Collaboration**: Share and collaborate with others in real-time
- **Easy Customization**: Select, copy, paste and customize components
- **Export & Publish**: Export diagrams and publish them publicly
- **Integration**: Combine with Google Documents and Spreadsheets for shared functional descriptions and item lists
- **Browser-Based**: No software installation required

### Getting Started:
1. Log in to your [Google Account](https://www.google.com/accounts/) (free to create)
2. Copy the [P&ID Drawing Template](https://docs.google.com/drawings/d/1e57jdajSDZWkeobjvz-st-50_8HyoZ7GwT37S-zSQNU/edit?usp=sharing) to your Google Drive
3. Select and customize components for your diagram
4. Share with team members for online collaboration
5. Export your completed diagram

**Note**: A credit to the Engineering ToolBox on your drawing would be appreciated.
